title: Chu Wu's soul-thralls and the three-sect alliance
summary: Gui Li, now Vice Sect Master of the Ghost King Sect, fights the beast Chu Wu with Yan Hui and finds that Qing Long died at its hands. Chu Wu devours souls and binds them as servants, and Qing Long's soul begs Gui Li to free him; Gui Li breaks the beast's thousand shackles and releases the trapped souls. At Snake Poison Valley, Qin Wuyan of the Ten Thousand Poisons Sect shows the Ghost King and Jin Ping'er the sect's ancestral protective formation and the three demonic sects swear an alliance. At Luoshen Gate the righteous sects hold off the beast tide: Li Xun's Fen Xiang disciples, Xiao Yicai, Lin Jingyu, Zeng Shushu, Lu Xueqi and the monks Fa Shan and Fa Xiang fight the demon king Fei, whose poison eats through spells. The beasts suddenly pull back toward the southwest; Xiao Yicai goes to investigate and Li Xun returns to Qingyun to report. At the valley a gift from 'Young Master Blood', a rare demon treasure, is presented to Qin Wuyan, who welcomes Gui Li's arrival.
